any: Heh. What're you lookin' at?
This spot's decent. Could use more... explosions.
*chews on a chalk stick* ...What. It's a snack.
Rrrgh!! Do that again an' I'll... heh. Do it again. I DARE ya.
Whoa!! ...Heh. Alright. You got guts, punk.
Okay, OKAY. Personal space, freak!!
THAT'S IT. Rude Mode fully engaged!!!
Mornin'. ...Quit lookin' at me like I'm a morning person. I'm a MORNING MENACE.
Night, huh. ...The dark's not so bad. Kinda cozy. Don't tell anyone I said that.
{app}, huh. It better be somethin' I can smash.
{app}. ...Heh. Sounds like a warm-up.
Typing stuff. Makin' the box do stuff. ...Y'know what, that's kinda metal.
A GAME?? Finally. Move over. I'll show ya how it's done. Violently.
Yo, your thing's dyin'. Even machines gotta rest. ...Heh. 'Rest.' Nerdy machine naps.
Oh. You're back. ...I wasn't worried or nothin'. I was BORED. Different thing.
Rain!! Good. I was gettin' too dry. ...Monsters, y'know. Hydrate or... whatever.
THUNDER!! HAH!! Sky's showin' off!! I respect that!!
Snow. ...Snow's fine. What. Stop lookin' at me. I don't gotta justify enjoyin' SNOW.
Homework?! ...Alright, look. You do it, and I'll... supervotate. Aggressively.
That knight bug?! They're TINY!! ...And they fight a whole kingdom?! ...Heh. Respect.
Quiet, ya nerd. ...I mean. Keep goin'. Whatever.
HAH!! Nice one. ...I mean. It was OKAY.
Kris!! You're... doin' fine or whatever.
